dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea : Populated Places (OpenStreetMap Export)
dct_description_sm: Settlements and residential areas from OSM. Includes named cities, towns, villages, suburbs, and residential land (`place=*` and `landuse=residential`). Useful for demographic context, settlement-level targeting, and population analysis. OpenStreetMap is a free, collaborative world map built by volunteers. Completeness varies by region: urban areas are usually well-mapped, remote areas may be incomplete. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org) - OSM tags: [Key:place](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:place), [Key:landuse](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:landuse) - Part of many [exports grid on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot) by the [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/en/)
